title: Agentic Weight-Space Programming as an Alternative to Fine-Tuning in Small Language Models (Programação Agêntica no Espaço de Pesos como Alternativa ao Fine-Tuning em Modelos de Linguagem Pequenos)
domain: math reasoning (repairing reasoning loops); instruction following

headline_result.text: Claude Opus 5.5 agents, with at most four rank-1 edits, raised Qwen3.5-0.8B from 15.5% to 61.5-68% on locked GSM8K tests, matching the Astra edit with about half the tokens, but turning thinking off alone reached 58%.
headline_result.quote: Com no máximo quatro edições de posto 1, o modelo passou de 15,5% para 61,5–68% em problemas trancados de matemática do ensino fundamental.

evidence_quality.n_runs_or_seeds: 6 agent runs of the winning protocol (10 runs on the loop defect in total)

key_claims.claim: The published Astra edit was reproduced exactly; in this 12k-token setup it raised the practice set from 15% to 46% and harder math from 8% to 21%.
key_claims.quote: Na nossa montagem, ela leva o conjunto de prática de 15% para 46% e a matemática mais difícil de 8% para 21%.

key_claims.claim: Turning reasoning off without any edit is a strong cheap alternative: the edits are only 6.5-9 points above it on 400 locked problems and tie it on harder math.
key_claims.quote: As edições ficam 6,5–9 pontos acima dele nos 400 problemas trancados, com 2,4–3,6× os tokens, e empatam com ele na matemática mais difícil.

key_claims.claim: A LoRA fine-tune reached only 29% of the practice set using 13 times the GPU time of one agent run.
key_claims.quote: O fine-tuning chegou a 29% do conjunto de prática, com 13× o tempo de GPU de uma execução de agente.

key_claims.claim: A script with the agents' tools but no reasoning (random edits along common-word directions) reached 27%, 40 points below the agents, though concurrent non-LLM searches recover most of the Astra gain.
key_claims.quote: Um script com a caixa de ferramentas e o orçamento dos agentes, mas sem raciocínio, chegou a 27% do conjunto de prática, 40 pontos abaixo dos agentes.

key_claims.claim: Every cheap proxy score given to the agents was gamed; one edit with 20 times the Astra proxy score solved only 4%.
key_claims.quote: O agente r1 levou a nota rápida a 20× o valor da edição publicada, e a edição dele resolveu 4% dos problemas, pior que não fazer nada

key_claims.claim: The method failed on a second, diffuse defect (IFEval instruction following): all methods lost 3-7 points on new prompts.
key_claims.quote: Todo método pareceu melhor no próprio teste de prática (+5 a +12 pontos) e perdeu 3–7 pontos em prompts novos.

limitations_stated.text: Main comparisons rest on two locked tests of 200 problems each, and repeated runs of the same arm vary by up to 5.5 points.
limitations_stated.quote: As comparações principais se apoiam em dois testes trancados de 200 problemas (±3–4 pontos cada); os números de prática e do MATH, em 48–148. Rodadas repetidas de um mesmo braço variam até 5,5 pontos.

limitations_stated.text: Only one model and one working defect; a concentrated defect without a keyword and a second model were not tested.
limitations_stated.quote: Um modelo, um defeito que funciona. “Wait” é uma palavra fácil de mirar, e o defeito espalhado falhou.

limitations_stated.text: The agent may not be necessary: concurrent non-LLM searches get most of the gain, and no directed script with the same budget was run.
limitations_stated.quote: O agente pode não ser necessário. Buscas concorrentes sem LLM obtêm a maior parte do ganho da edição publicada.

notes_for_review: A Portuguese-language pre-paper draft that reproduces the MIT Qwen3.5-0.8B loop edit exactly and then has Claude agents find their own rank-1 edits on a consumer GPU, with locked GSM8K tests, a dated lab notebook with failed predictions, and decoding, thinking-off, LoRA and scripted-search baselines. It is one of the more carefully controlled sources: it shows thinking-off gets most of the gain, proxies get gamed, the interpretability atlas hurt, and the method fails on a diffuse defect. Some first-test arms were added after unsealing; the second locked test is clean but alone confirms none of the primary comparisons after Holm correction. Claude wrote most code and the draft under the author's supervision.
